points.point: R&S VNA 的每條規格必須標示型號與文件版次，且數字要連測試條件一起抄，不可自行補齊原文沒有的 option code 或料號
points.label: covered
points.why: requires exact R&S model/configuration, formal specs, versioned ZNA document, test conditions, and actual option codes

points.point: 比較時必須區分 specification / typical / nominal / measured 等級，因為來源明示 R&S 不保證 non-traceable specifications、typical、nominal、measured 值
points.label: covered
points.why: distinguishes warranted/specification, typical, nominal, measured and notes R&S does not guarantee these non-traceable values

points.point: 性能數字（如 dynamic range）必須附上量測條件，例如 measurement bandwidth 與是否套用 user correction
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions measurement bandwidth and calibration/test conditions, but not user correction specifically

points.point: Vault 對競品 VNA（Keysight PNA）的唯一來源未列型號、頻率範圍、option code 或校準件，且未提供任何性能指標，不足以支撐規格對比
points.label: covered
points.why: states current Keysight ENA/PNA evidence lacks model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, and performance indicators

points.point: R&S 內部 battle card 對競品的描述屬單一來源，用於客戶文件前需以競品官方資料或第三方資料驗證
points.label: covered
points.why: says battle-card descriptions need competitor official or third-party validation before use

points.point: only platform、leadership、lower TCO 等 sales language 不可當作可驗證技術規格，且 TCO 主張沒有算式或實證資料
points.label: partial
points.why: warns against sales positioning, but does not specifically address only platform/leadership/lower TCO or missing TCO formula/evidence

points.point: 半導體相關的 ZNA / ZNA67EXT 對應只來自 Excel solution mapping，該欄不是正式 datasheet / application note / configuration guide，不得據此報價或建立測試配置，也未提供 option / fixture / calibration 條件
points.label: contradicted
points.why: introduces other semiconductor-use sources and ZNB40/Advantest/Meritech instead of the reference’s only Excel ZNA/ZNA67EXT mapping limitation

points.point: 半導體客戶與 R&S solution 同列不代表已購買、評估、合作或導入，不能作為客戶實證
points.label: partial
points.why: notes sales-case mentions lack procurement status, but does not clearly state company co-listing is not purchase/evaluation/cooperation/adoption proof
